integrity: The proof is symbolic and cardinal-theoretic. No finite experiment, search failure, or inaccessible source is used as proof of the mathematical statement or as proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to principal intervals from the canonical minimum in a full power-set lattice.
It does not classify arbitrary intervals or replace the focal source general bounds for arbitrary distributive lattices.
Historical uniqueness is not certified; an equivalent older formulation under different terminology remains possible.
title: Exact density of principal Boolean intervals in a free Banach lattice
